BranchOutcome.description: A counterfactual branch may stop before the end; it is then not a comparable ending score.
BranchOutcome.title: BranchOutcome

Break.description: A control discrepancy; ``actual``/``expected`` are diagnostic text, not always numbers.
Break.title: Break

Certificate.description: ``shadow.certify``: one NAV certificate per dealing close; dealing proceeds only when ``certified``.
Certificate.title: Certificate

CommandBody.description: The request body. A root model keeps the ``type`` discriminator, which FastAPI's ``Body()`` would drop.
CommandBody.title: CommandBody

ContactLp.description: Managing partner: spend this window's attention on one LP before its next review (generated rooms).
ContactLp.title: ContactLp

ControlReport.description: ``Engine.control_report``: scoped reconciliation, not external NAV certification (see ``scope``).
ControlReport.title: ControlReport

Debrief.description: ``POST /api/rooms/{id}/debrief``: completed-run causal replay, optionally omitting one decision.
Debrief.title: Debrief

DeclineProspect.description: Campaign, managing partner: reject the prospective LP; any escrow returns to it.
DeclineProspect.title: DeclineProspect

Investors.description: The managing partner's LP inbox in generated rooms; exact confidence stays server-side until the debrief.
Investors.title: Investors

LedgerPage.description: ``GET /api/rooms/{id}/ledger``: entries ``next - len(entries)`` up to ``next`` of one entity's journal.
LedgerPage.title: LedgerPage

LpDebrief.description: Generated rooms: every LP confidence component, revealed only after the run.
LpDebrief.title: LpDebrief

MacroPrint.description: One published print of a generated market's indicator; a later revision appears only from its own day.
MacroPrint.title: MacroPrint

Notice.description: A typed event; ``text`` is rendered prose, ``code``/``refs`` are what logic should read.
Notice.title: Notice

ProposeAdmission.description:
Campaign: propose admitting the funded prospect at ``amount`` (full or capped); the other partner's ``sign``
consents.
ProposeAdmission.title: ProposeAdmission

ProposeGate.description: Propose a redemption gate for the next dealing close; the other partner elects it with ``sign``.
ProposeGate.title: ProposeGate

ProposeWinddown.description: Campaign: propose a joint controlled winddown; the other partner's ``sign`` declares it.
ProposeWinddown.title: ProposeWinddown

ProspectView.description: Campaign fundraising pipeline as this seat may know it. Escrow is outside the fund: not NAV or collateral.
ProspectView.title: ProspectView

ResearchRecord.description: Brier scores of each seat's latest thesis per question; beside P&L, never in it.
ResearchRecord.title: ResearchRecord

RoomView.description: ``GET /api/rooms/{id}/view``: the session view plus seat names and the real-time clock.
RoomView.title: RoomView

TerminalView.description: ``GET /api/rooms/{id}/terminal``: read-only as-of analytics at one room version.
TerminalView.title: TerminalView

Thesis.description: A seat's forecast for the terminal's live regime question; scored in the debrief, never in P&L.
Thesis.title: Thesis
